claim: G30: an independent, non-networked Mattermost mock trial can establish whether the quarantined Miter-authored G29 candidate preserves the typed surface contract across authorization, duplicate/edit delivery, send failure and same-key retry, restart cursor recovery, and causally severed controls.
non_claims: No live Mattermost access, credential use, adapter activation, promotion, production readiness, unconditional exactly-once guarantee for an incapable destination, new model call, hand-authored repair of the candidate, complete Soul cognition, or G31 result. The initial trial may honestly fail and return a typed repair consequence instead of closing G30.
rationale: G29 proved source-grounded authorship and quarantine but its candidate-owned unit tests do not independently prove failure witnessing, safe retry after an uncertain/failed send, durable restart state, or causal dependence on identity and idempotency controls. G30 supplies an independent mock and severed arms before any live grant.
reading: Retain both control documents and the complete fidelity ledger. Reread ACCEPTANCE G29-G31; G29 R9 plan, outcome and exact candidate provenance; the generic surface event/effect schemas; C-064-C-066 and C-090-C-103; S-804, S-903-S-905, S-1003-S-1005 and S-1101-S-1105. Candidate-authored tests remain non-authoritative input.
representation: Represent mock deliveries, request attempts, returned failures, witnesses, durable cursor/dedupe/effect state, and restart readback as typed evidence. Treat candidate behavior as an encountered consequence. A failure is neither repaired nor called success; it becomes source-grounded input to a separately frozen native revision continuation.
consumer: PeTTa/MeTTa constructs the trial standing and compares returned relations. The quarantined Prolog candidate maps typed frames/effects. A separate Prolog mock owns deterministic service mechanics and request logging. Builder JavaScript freezes fixtures, launches isolated processes, hashes evidence, and verifies causal severing; it does not choose runtime behavior or repair candidate code.
falsifiers: An unauthorized payload reaches a canonical event; duplicate delivery creates a second event; edit identity is lost; a failed send is silently recorded as success; retry changes its idempotency key or is suppressed before a confirmed receipt; restart loses or advances the wrong cursor; removing identity or idempotency participation does not make the corresponding forbidden case pass/fail differently; mock logs disagree with effects; candidate source is silently changed; a credential, network call, model call, core modification, activation, or promotion occurs.
scope_review: One offline trial of the exact G29 R9 candidate plus independently authored mock, durable test state, positive/adversarial fixtures, identity/idempotency severed variants, raw logs and verification. No network, credential, model, live service, candidate repair, promotion, push, persistent daemon, or change to protected controls. If a material candidate defect appears, preserve it and stop this slice before freezing a bounded repair plan.
rollback: All G30 execution occurs under evidence/runtime quarantine. Removing the G30 runtime copy and mock evidence restores the pre-trial state; the immutable G29 candidate and all failed observations remain in provenance. No promoted or live surface exists to roll back.
